_comment: Pinned repositories for the performance benchmark (scripts/perf-benchmark.ts).
Each commit is a full SHA, checked with `pnpm benchmark:perf -- --verify-only`.
`ref` records where the pin came from; it is never used to fetch.
`tier` is the intended size class; measured counts are recorded with every run.
No dependencies are installed: the production pipeline indexes a checkout as it is.

repositories.purpose: A small TypeScript library with a clean call graph: the baseline cost of a run.

setup.notes: Known incompatibility: tsconfig.json extends @sindresorhus/tsconfig, which exists only after an install. Without it scip-typescript fails with TS6053 and indexes nothing, so every run is expected to fail. Kept to record that, not replaced.

repositories.purpose: Plain CommonJS JavaScript with no tsconfig: exercises the JavaScript path and --infer-tsconfig.
A heavily generic TypeScript monorepo: overloads, declaration merging, and the root-tsconfig limitation.

setup.notes: A pnpm workspace. The pipeline indexes from the root and does not pass --pnpm-workspaces, so coverage depends on the root tsconfig.

repositories.purpose: An Express and Prisma service: exercises the route and database analyzers.

setup.notes: Prisma client is generated at install time and is absent.

repositories.ref: a4af862, resolved to the full SHA (committed 2026-09-24, the revision of docs/real-repository-validation-report.md)
repositories.purpose: A production NestJS and Kysely server: the prior validation baseline, at the same revision.

setup.notes: Only server/ is indexed. A cone-mode sparse checkout fetches server/ plus the files at the repository root.
